translation: First use manual technique to turn the sinews and set the bone, restoring it to its position, then use a bamboo board (竹板) to clamp and fix the heel bone, binding it to the hang bone (胻骨). After three days untie the binding and look; support the back of the foot with a pillow, support the sinews with the hand, and then press the places where the sinews are knotted with the fingertips, and must make them level and even. Administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, moxa-iron with Dingtong San (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散), wash with Haitongpi Tang (Erythrina Bark Decoction, 海桐皮湯), and regularly take Jianbu Huqian Wan (Agile-Steps Tiger-Crouching Pill, 健步虎潛丸).
